- George Gatch | Chief Executive Officer, J.P. Morgan Asset Management George Gatch is a veteran asset management leader with four decades of experience building one of the world’s largest and most diversified investment franchises. As Chief Executive Officer of J.P. Morgan Asset Management, he chairs the Asset Management Operating Committee and serves on the Asset and Wealth Management Operating Committee, overseeing a global business that manages more than $4.5 trillion across equities, fixed
